maintenance_led.reason: Sells branded CNS drugs (Qelbree, Oxtellar XR, Trokendi XR, Gocovri) as prescription product sales, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from US prescription drug sales paid largely through commercial insurers and pharmacy channels; government share is not clearly the majority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling and launching its own marketed CNS products; the Sage Therapeutics and US WorldMeds deals are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Epilepsy, Parkinson's and ADHD therapies are clinically stabilised treatments, so switching carries medical risk and needs prescriber involvement.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call, since generics exist for some products. Government payer share is not stated in the text.
